description: Return the full text of an indexed open-access paper by its corpus key (e.g. 'arxiv:2310.12345'), paginated by passage. Use from_seq + max_passages to page through it. For works not indexed locally, returns a pointer to find the open-access URL via paper_search / paper_details.

from_seq.description: Passage index to start from (0-based, default 0).

max_passages.description: Maximum passages to return per call (default 40, max 200).

paper_key.description: Corpus key of an indexed paper, e.g. 'arxiv:2310.12345' or 'pmc:PMC1234567'.

name: paper_get_text
